CII TOWER 152 Dien Bien Phu - Ward 25 - Binh Thanh District - Ho Chi Minh City OPEN LETTER Dear Tenants, Your office is a part of CII Tower, operated by the CII Tower MOof CBRE Vietnam Co., Ltd., appointed by Dien Bien Phu Building Investment Company Limited (OBI) to manage this building on its behalf. With the motto of always being customer-centric, we keep in mind that: The prosperity of tenants always accompanies the development of CII TOWER. Therefore, we look forward to receiving the cooperation and cooperation of you to join us in preserving and perfecting the quality of service here. Our Client Handbook is designed to help tenants get useful information in their day-to-day operations at the Building. We are always ready to listen and promptly respond to tenants' questions, please contact CII Tower MO Board, hereinafter referred to as Building MO Office (MO), when you have questions related to the following regulations. On behalf of the Board of Directors of Dien Bien Phu Building Investment Company Limited (OBI), CBRE Vietnam Co ., Ltd. is pleased to welcome you and believe that you will feel satisfied when working in an environment with quality MO in accordance with international quality standards. Respect CII Tower MO Board 4 BUILDING HANDBOOK|

CII TOWER 152 Dien Bien Phu - Ward 25 - Binh Thanh District - Ho Chi Minh City PART I: PURPOSE, SCOPE, SUBJECTS OF APPLICATION 1. Purpose The "Building Handbook" document aims to help building users/operators have complete and detailed information about the building as well as the requirements of the Building MO Office during operation to achieve the highest efficiency. 2. Scope of application This handbook applies to the MO of buildings at CII Tower: General regulations of the Building, Rules on fire protection, vehicle MO, regulations on construction and minor repair ... and guidance for implementation in emergencies. 3. Subjects of application The building handbook applies to all offices of units using/operating at CII Tower, including but not limited to units under the City People's Committee, under the Department of Transport, lessees, employees of office lessees, contractors, suppliers ... in the process of entering / exiting, operating activities at the building. 4. Related documents - Construction Manual - Emergency Handbook 5. Explanation of terms and acronyms a. Explanation of terms - Company/Lessor: Dien Bien Phu Building Investment Company Limited (OBI) - Building MO Office: the operating unit of CII Tower is assigned/appointed by CBRE Vietnam Company Limited (CBRE) – the company is assigned the right / appointed to manage and operate the building. - Contractor: Is a company or individual responsible for providing the bidding services specified in the Contract and is responsible to the investor, the law for the quality of work undertaken by them, compensation for damages when violating the Contract. - Common area: The public area of the building is owned by the Lessor, jointly used by the Lessor , the users of the Building (units directly under the City People's Committee, under the Department of Transport, the Tenants of the Building) or visitors to the Building. "Common Area" includes the foyer, hallways, walkways, stairs, elevators, toilets in the Building and other areas determined by the Lessor. - Commercial Floor: including Ground Floor and Level 2 called Commercial Floor. The ground floor is partly the common public area of the building. b. Acronyms 5 BUILDING HANDBOOK|

MO Office – Contact Number Office - At: MO Office – 11th Floor -Tel: (028) 35359152 - Hotline: 0846 99 00 88 Working Hours: - From 08:00 to 18:00 from Monday to Friday - From 08:00 to 12:00 on Saturdays The above-mentioned contact numbers, including the emergency contact number of the 6 BUILDING HANDBOOK|

CII TOWER 152 Dien Bien Phu - Ward 25 - Binh Thanh District - Ho Chi Minh City PART III: GENERAL PROVISIONS 1. General Provisions of the Building - Comply with signs and rules of the Building; - Do not smoke in the building, only eat in the right place; - Do not use alcohol in the Building, do not bring narcotic or drug-related substances, incendiary, explosive, toxic substances, weapons into the Building. - Do not light incense in the office or any area within the Building without the consent of the MO. - Persons who appear to be drunk and mentally ill are not allowed to enter the Building. - Park in the right place, comply with the regulations and instructions of the parking manager. - Do not open windows (if any), they can only be used in case of emergency. - Must dress politely when entering/leaving the Building. - No running, screaming in the Building. - Visitors to contact the Company/Unit or Contractor working on the premises of the Building must always wear the " Visitor" or "Contractor" card issued at the reception desk or at the Security desk. - Do not wear a hat, mask, when entering the Building. - No pets are brought into the Building area. - No trouble, harassment or damage to the Developer or other TENANTS is permitted. - Do not use, obstruct emergency exits, comply with the regulations on use prescribed by competent fire protection agencies. - Do not obstruct or unsanitary elevators and other common areas. - Do not hang clothes, laundry outside the Building as well as in the Common Area. - Do not stay, live overnight (only work overtime when pre-registered with the Building MO), do not cook, store goods and conduct activities that are not related or strictly prohibited in the Rented Area. - Do not gamble or organize gambling of any kind. - Contractors and TENANTS must comply with the rules and regulations of the Building and comply with regulations on disease prevention. - TENANTS are responsible for disseminating the rules and regulations of the Building to their contractors, partners and visitors when entering and leaving the Building. 8 BUILDING HANDBOOK|

CII TOWER 152 Dien Bien Phu - Ward 25 - Binh Thanh District - Ho Chi Minh City - When detecting any abnormal problems, it is necessary to immediately notify the MOas soon as possible. Regulations on working time ("Executive Hours" ) and overtime ("Outside of Office 2. Hours") Office hours are prescribed as follows: For Office for lease: Monday to Friday: from 08:00 to 18:00 o o Saturday: from 08 :00 to 12:00 o Excludes Sundays and public holidays. - When TENANTS in demand in/in Building outside of administrative working hoursh, for security reasons, TENANTS must register at the Customer Service Department and declare at the reception desk or Security desk. - When the TENANT wishes to work overtime and needs to use air conditioning, please fill out the form " Request form for after-hours air conditioning" (Refer to BM11/ST. OBI .01 in "Forms"). The provision of this service is for a fee. The unit of charge for air conditioning outside office hours is one (01) floor, although the actual area of the TENANT using air conditioning is less than 01 floor (this section only applies to office tenants, commercial floors, floors of units under the City People's Committee, under the Department of Transportation pays for air conditioning itself). Without prior registration, the building's elevator system may cease service after 18 : 00 on Monday to Friday, after 12:00 on Saturday and allday Sunday. - In all cases of working outside office hours, THE TENANT needs to register 24 hours in advance the List of employees working overtime (after 18h00) at the office floors according to the registration form BM14/ST. OBI.01 (from Monday to Saturday and Sunday). For Commercial Floor, Lessee and its guests have the right to enter / exit and work during the operation period from 08h:00 to 22h:00 on Monday to Sunday. In case there is a need to leave / enter earlier or later than this 01 (one) hour, the Lessee is responsible for notifying the MOof the number of people entering / leaving late / earlier than 24 hours. - For the security of the Building, especially in the current complicated Covid epidemic situation, TENANTS need to declare the number of their employees when operating at the building according to the form BM01/ST. OBI.01 and updates to the MO when there is a change in the number of employees. - Unit prices of services will be notified in writing from time to time as appropriate. Note that Lessor have the right to adjust this unit price as necessary or corresponding to the 9 BUILDING HANDBOOK|

Parking Regulations Parking hours of operation a. - Opening hours: from 06:00 to 22:00 (excluding holidays, Tet holidays,..) - Parking overnight and during holidays, holidays... will be charged for night storage (Refer to the parking price in the basement of B1 Building) Parking Registration - Parking Fee b. - Depending on the contractual agreement, each TENANT will only be able to register a certain number of motorcycles and cars to be parked in the Building. - THE TENANT must proceed with the parking registration procedure for his/her employees according to (Form BM05/ST. OBI.01 and sent to the MO Office for approval (Note: Parking registration form is notified or posted from time to time as appropriate) - Depending on the rental agreement, the parking fee must be paid in full after the Lessor/MO sends a notice and the TENANT receives a valid payment record. - Parking attendants must pay the cost of parking in the number of days and only apply for the first month when registering for parking. - The paid parking fee will not be refunded if the Parking Person does not park during the registered parking period. - The paid parking fee is refundable if the MO receives notice at least 15 days before the date of the request to stop using the parking space if the TENANT does not have a need for parking for 30 days or more. - The taxes that are associated with these parking costs are borne by the Parking Person. - A parking card is integrated with only one vehicle (motorcycle or car). c. No concessions - Only vehicles that match the information indicated in the parking registration form sent to the MO are allowed to use the parking facilities along with the issued car card. - Absolutely do not transfer parking vouchers / parking cards. d. Change parking information - Notice must be given to the Lessor immediately ( in writing) (Form BM06/ST. OBI.01) if there is a change in the license plate, otherwise the MO reserves the right not to allow this new vehicle into the parking lot. - In this case, although parking is not allowed, the holder of the car card is not entitled to a refund, nor can any claim be made against the Lessor. 10 BUILDING HANDBOOK|

CII TOWER 152 Dien Bien Phu - Ward 25 - Binh Thanh District - Ho Chi Minh City Parking validity and renewal e. - The car card is validfor the duration of the contract. - Registration for parking renewals (in special cases) must be made before the 25th of the month, before the start of the next parking cycle. - The Lessor / MO reserves the right not to approve the registration of parking extensions for vehicles that are not covered by the agreement of the lease. f. Cost of parking card replacement/cancellation - In case the card is damaged or lost, the TENANT / parking person must immediately report it to the MO Board. Replacement costs will be announced, listed in appropriate stages and paid by the TENANT. - In case the TENANT wishes to cancel the car card, please notify at least 02 days before the cancellation date and send the cancellation card (not used) to the office of the MO up to 03 days after the cancellation registration date for support in canceling the car card according to BM07/ST. OBI. 01. - MO is not responsible if TENANTS failure to fulfill 1 of the above 2 conditions. Costs will be announced from time to time (usually the cost is pegged on the 30th of every month). TENANTS will be charged a 1/2-month parking fee if the subscription cancels before the 15th of each month and a full month if the subscription cancels after the 15th of each month. g. Liability - The Lessor / MO is not responsible for loss, damage, injury, accident, or other errors caused to the user's vehicle, its equipment, or components when the vehicle is parked in the permitted parking area if it is not the fault of the Lessor / MO. - The parking person is liable for damage or injury he or she causes to the Building or part or all of its property. - In the event of a loss of the person's vehicle permitted to park in the permitted parking area of the Building, Lessor / The MO is responsible for supervising the compensation for damages between the person who is allowed to park the car and the legally authorized party to look after the parking lot. - TENANTS registering parking spaces must ensure that all employees permitted to use the parking lot comply with the terms stated above. - Comply with signs and notices in the parking lot - The parking person, at all times, is responsible for complying with the signs, parking rules, signage as well as other bulletin boards placed in the parking lot. h. Rights of the Lessor 11 BUILDING HANDBOOK|

CII TOWER 152 Dien Bien Phu - Ward 25 - Binh Thanh District - Ho Chi Minh City - The Lessor has the right to modify any of the above provisions and has the right to change the parking fee for cars and motorcycles , change the cost of replacing parking cards, etc. according to the time limit agreed with the TENANT. i. Parking rules - All vehicles entering/exiting the basement are required to swipe the card at the entrance and exit from Dien Bien Phu gate . - A parking area is an area reserved for parking that is not used for other purposes. - Must follow the instructions or directions of the security guard or parking lot operator. - Must always follow the rules, signs, signals in the parking lot as well as the regulations stated in the car card. - Park in the right place, do not park in the aisle or where it may interfere with the parking and movement of others. - MO reserves the right to relocate any vehicle that violates these regulations without prior notice. MO also reserves the right to remove vehicles that cause obstruction and nuisance to others from the parking area. All costs for the above relocation will be borne by the car owner. - With cars, after parking, make sure the car door is closed and locked. With motorcycles and bicycles, no neck locks, locking the forks. - The owner of the vehicle, the driver shall be liable for damage or injury caused to persons, property of the Building or other related property as a result of his careless acts. - Smoking, drinking, gambling, littering, defecation, acts of violence, vandalism, disturbance, theft or carrying flammable substances in the parking lot are prohibited. - The maximum speed in the parking area and access road is 5km/h. - Do not repair or wash the car in the parking lot including in the basement. - Children under the age of 18 entering the parking area must be accompanied by an adult and an adult is responsible for custody. - All vehicles must not honk their horns in the parking area, do not run around in the parking area for more than 5 minutes. - Do not sleep overnight in the parking lot. - The vehicle card must not be transferred to someone else for use and it must be returned (the parking manager) before picking up the car. - Do not leave your possessions/personal items in your car. MO is not responsible for the loss of property left on the vehicle. 12 BUILDING HANDBOOK|

CII TOWER 152 Dien Bien Phu - Ward 25 - Binh Thanh District - Ho Chi Minh City - When the vehicle card is lost, it must be immediately reported to the checkpoint to isolate the vehicle and carry out the necessary procedures. The MOreserves the right to hold the car until there is legal evidence, or until a valid vehicle card is received - Free upon first card issuance. When the card is lost or damaged, the customer incurs a cost of 100. 000VND per motorbike card and 200,000VND per car card. (This fee may vary depending on consideration from the Developer/ MO). - In case of forgetting the card or losing the card that has not been reissued, the customer must park in the visitor's area and pay the same parking fee as with the visitor. - The MOwill not bear all relevant responsibilities if the vehicle owner does not comply with the above regulations. j. Fire protection rules. To ensure the safety of life, property and security in the Building, everyone must fully comply with the regulations on fire protection as follows: - Fire protection is the obligation of all officers and employees including office tenants, visitors and contractors working in offices. - Each person must be vigilant against any possibility of causing a fire. Absolutely comply with fire protection regulations such as: It is forbidden to use fire, cook, burn incense, burn votive gold, smoke the area inside the building. - It is forbidden to connect to use electricity arbitrarily, strictly comply with regulations on safety techniques in electricity use. Before leaving the office, check to turn off and disconnect the power supply of unnecessary electrical equipment, do not leave flammable items such as papers, documents ... near incendiary objects. - Do not use a power cord plugged directly into an outlet; - Do not leave items near circuit breakers, electrical panels and power lines; - Do not use homemade electrical appliances, lack of safety; - Do not bring poisons, explosives, flammable substances and sources that may generate fire into the Building. - The workplace, including the Office of the MO Board, the office of the TENANT, the tools and working facilities must be arranged neatly and neatly. - Arrange materials and goods in the warehouse must be neatly and cleanly arranged separately from each type with a fire prevention space, away from the roof, at least 50cm away from the wall to facilitate inspection and treatment when necessary. - Firefighting equipment must be in a conspicuous, easy-to-get place, no one can use it for other things. 13 BUILDING HANDBOOK|

CII TOWER 152 Dien Bien Phu - Ward 25 - Binh Thanh District - Ho Chi Minh City - Firefighting devices and tools equipped in areas of the building must be regularly maintained and checked periodically, ensuring that they are always in a state of readiness and operate well, promptly and effectively during firefighting. - The vehicle must not start when loading and unloading and the driver must be in the vehicle. - Do not refill gasoline, oil in the garage. Do not leave obstacles on the walkways and escape stairs. - In the process of completing the interior, repairing the office, it is necessary to use flammable tools, fire-related works must be notified to apply for approval from the MO Board, have a permanent inspection and supervision force. - When detecting suspicious and unsafe signs, it is necessary to immediately notify the Building MO Office or a competent person to handle. - The TENANT is responsible for disseminating this rule to the employees and related customers under its MO. PART IV: REGULATIONS ON CONSTRUCTION OF MINOR REPAIRS Scope of application 1. - Applicable to construction contents that do not cause dust, noise, odor, do not affect the structure, design of the operating office or building. For example, changing burning light bulbs, cleaning carpets, spraying insects, repairing furniture (tables, chairs, counters, cabinets, shelves...) - In the case of TENANTS if there is a need for construction and repair related to the fire protection system, construction related to the electrical system, changes in the design of the leased premises, or items that are prone to fire and explosion, please refer to Construction manual and notify the MOTN for assistance. 2. General provisions - All contractors must be absolutely careful during construction, not littering or damaging anything talent Production which of The building. Do not cause nuisance, unpleasant odors, noise, vibrations or inconvenience to other Tenants in the Building. All workers must wear uniforms and must not be arbitrary in/in leased areas other than the construction site and public areas of the building. - TENANTS must register for minor repairs according to form BM15/ST. OBI. 01 for approval by the MObefore implementation. In 1 number of cases, the MO will ask the TENANT to authorize the contractor before construction according to BM02/ST. OBI. 03. - The contractor must report and register at the Security Department when entering / leaving 14 BUILDING HANDBOOK|

CII TOWER 152 Dien Bien Phu - Ward 25 - Binh Thanh District - Ho Chi Minh City the Building and before starting work. - All rules related to fire safety must be complied with such as emergency corridors, emergency stairs, doors of fire extinguishing equipment cabinets must be clean and unobstructed and always closed. - All supplies and construction work performed by the TENANT's contractor are deployed only in the rented area. - Must notify the MO (in writing ) 2 (two) days in advance if it is necessary to isolate the fire alarm system of that floor for the construction of works related to the fire protection system. - The contractor must temporarily carefully cover the smoke sensors around the construction area to prevent dust from hitting the smoke sensor head as it can trigger the fire alarm system (create a fake fire alarm). The contractor will be fined at least VND 50,000,000 (Fifty million VND even) for each false fire alarm if the cause is due to non-compliance with this regulation. - All work related to the Fire Protection system must be completed by 17:00 and the fire alarm system must be restored to operation by removing the covering from the smoke induction head. - Must cover the floor, elevator, door to the area TENANTS carefully before starting work. - Any drilling, threshing, painting, varnishing or other work that causes trouble or inconvenience to others must be done after office hours, namely after 19:00 daily, or after 13:00 on Monday or Sunday. - Contractors must provide themselves, install objects that cover corridors, elevator lobby areas or places that they use as walkways, transporting supplies. - The construction supervisor or responsible for construction must always be present at the site during the construction period. - During the construction period, the contractor is not allowed to turn on (open) refrigeration system (RS) in the area under construction. - The contractor is responsible for carrying out cleaning work in the construction area and outside the construction area if it affects. Cleaning work above the decorative ceiling must also be carried out to protect the air conditioning system and electromechanical systems of the building. - All workers must wear tags, uniforms, protective shoes at all times and in some cases must wear work helmets, seat belts and other equipment in accordance with the current construction safety specifications of Vietnam. - It is necessary to closely contact MO regarding other relevant details or requirements. 3. Regulations on Entering and Exiting the building 15 BUILDING HANDBOOK|

OBI.01 in "Forms"). - The contractor and workers must enter and exit the building by the entrance at the back corner/basement or other walkway as designated by the MO Board. Use of toilets – Washrooms 4. - Contractors do not use restrooms and washrooms on floors (except by special agreement with the TENANT) but must use designated restrooms from time to time. - It is forbidden not to dump garbage, waste ... to toilets, urinals, washbasins or trash cans in the toilet. Do not stand on the toilet surface, bathe, wash in the toilet, washing room. - The contractor, although allowed to use the (designated) toilet, is solely responsible for the damage, loss or blockage caused by him when using it. - In the event that the Contractor is permitted to use the toilet and/or washroom on the floor under construction, the Contractor shall ensure that its facilities are not abused, and the Lessor reserves the right to revoke this right of use at any time. 5. Regulations on the use of stairs - elevators - Stairs are allowed to be used to transport supplies, garbage, interior equipment for offices. - With the permission of the MO, the TENANT can use the Elevator to transport supplies, garbage, and interior equipment for the office. Contractors and workers must be very careful not to damage or overload the elevator. - TENANTS, representative TENANTS must carry out procedures for registration of using the elevator according to BM10/ST. OBI.03 before transporting goods and supplies and will be responsible for any damage that occurs (if applicable) due to him/herself, his/her employees or his/her contractors when using it. - Elevators reserved for THE TENANT may not be used for the purposes of transporting goods and supplies unless agreed in writing by the MO from time to time. - The specific elevator arrangement for the TENANT will be agreed upon separately by the Lessor with the Tenants. 6. Regulation does not clog the aisle - TENANTS and Contractors must ensure that supplies and tools are kept only in the area of TENANTS. - Any items that clog the hallway, emergency exit must be cleared immediately and if the Lessor does so, all costs will be borne by the TENANT or the TENANT's Contractor . 7. Regulations on occupational safety – construction 16 BUILDING HANDBOOK|

CII TOWER 152 Dien Bien Phu - Ward 25 - Binh Thanh District - Ho Chi Minh City - The contractor must always monitor and comply with applicable laws and safety rules and bear all costs associated with it. - Contractors are responsible for purchasing construction-related insurance under current laws including but not limited to construction insurance (covering all construction and installation risks), accident insurance ... and ready to present upon request from the Board of Directors. 8. Water and electricity use regulations - Contractors may not arbitrarily connect to use electricity from sockets in public areas. - The contractor must require workers to turn off all lights, cut off the power supply, and lock the faucet as soon as the work ends each day. - It is strictly forbidden to use water from the fire extinguishing system for construction. 9. Illegal workers - The contractor must ensure that illegal workers are not employed. - Foreign workers must have a work permit in Vietnam. PART V: MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS 1. Transportation of supplies - When there is a need for transportation, loading and unloading of goods, the TENANT, the authorized contractor of the TENANT must strictly follow the instructions of the Security Guard / MO staff or the authorized person of the Lessor. In addition, the TENANT or contractor authorized by the TENANT must complete the " Carrying Goods In / Out of the Building" (BM10/ST. OBI.03 ) and submit at least 1 (one) day in advance when the need arises or on a Friday if the transportation occurs on a Saturday or Sunday. - TENANTS provided to MO "Sample signature registration form” (BM08/ST. OBI.01) which TENANTS authorize the signing of consent for such things as the relocation of goods, property, or certain other functions. - In cases where freight requires the assistance of a cargo elevator, TENANTS, represented by TENANTS or Authorized Contractor of TENANTS must complete the information in the form “Cargo slips in/in Building” (BM10/ST. OBI.03). Note: Although agreed by the MO Board, TENANTS still responsible, the consequences caused to the elevator when used. 2. General hygiene – Garbage transportation - To ensure general hygiene, the Lessor shall arrange a number of garbage containers on the floors at the specified places. Note: Contractors are not allowed to use this trash can for 17 BUILDING HANDBOOK|

When there is a request to dispose of bulky items, it is necessary to contact the MO for special arrangements. - Absolutely do not remove chemicals, incendiary substances, explosives, toxic waste, construction waste into garbage containers, pipes, sanitary equipment of the Building. - Wet, organic-based garbage needs to be carefully packed before putting it in the bin. - Do not dump leftovers, remove waste products that risk clogging pipes into sanitary facilities. The TENANT bears the costs of restoring the operation of these devices if caused by his or her fault. - The waste and toilet paper after use must be disposed of in the right place. Notify the MO or cleaning staff as soon as there is a blockage or damage to the sanitary equipment. - Contributing to environmental protection, the MO encourages the sense of saving when using paper and water in the toilet area. - The Lessor uses a cleaning service provider to maintain general hygiene of public areas. Thebuilding's cleaning staff is not responsible for performing cleaning work in the area rented by the TENANT. - TENANTS Do not dispose of toxic waste, industrial waste (tables, chairs, cabinets, shelves, objects private construction...) in any area of the Building. The storage of combustible waste in the Leased Area or public area of the Building is strictly prohibited. 3. Insecticidal The Lessor contracts with professional service providers to treat insects for the public area of the Building periodically. MO encourages the TENANT to use this service provider when there is a need to handle inside the TENANT's area, the costs for the needs of this service will be covered by the TENANT. Note: Before proceeding with the treatment of insects in the rented area, the TENANT must notify the MOto have a plan to prepare the conditions accordingly. 4. Event Organization When there is a need to organize an event, the TENANT needs to complete the " Event Registration Form" according to (BM13/ST. OBI.01) and submit it to the MO at least 3 days before the event. THE TENANT can only proceed with the consent of the MO. The Tenant contacts the MO and proposes requirements and conditions to ensure the Lessor to support when necessary. 5. Maintenance and Repair 18 BUILDING HANDBOOK|

OBI.01). Backup key 6. - The TENANT is responsible for handing over 01 set of spare keys to the MO for emergency use as soon as the TENANT's Office comes into operation or every time a new lock is replaced. - The spare key will be sealed in an envelope with the signature and seal of the TENANT and kept in the Central Control Room. In case of emergency key use, the TENANT will notify the TENANT through 2 emergency contact numbers provided by the TENANT on the envelope. 7. Equipment that needs to be declared Tenants, customers of TENANTS, Contractors of TENANTS must declare: - Kitchen items ; - Household electrical appliances; - Materials that can cause fire and explosion such as gas, alcohol, gasoline, oil, charcoal, charcoal ...; - Instruments containing gas, oxygen, liquefied gas; - Chemicals that can produce odor, heat or fire; - Other items and equipment that do not comply with regulations and fire protection regulations; - Supplies, tools and equipment must have a license from the authorities. 8. Important notes - MO will assist in consulting for TENANTS if required. Therefore, TENANTS should contact the MO for advice before ordering, bringing the same items and equipment as above into your office. - Note that, despite the consent of the MO Board, the TENANT , the representative of the TENANT must still bear the responsibilities and consequences caused by the tools, 19 BUILDING HANDBOOK|

Sign up for a regular service provider Tenants are responsible for notifying and registering with the MO of regular service providers (insect spraying, periodic cleaning, protection, transportation, clerical ...) and/or personnel cleaning and protecting regularly and as soon as there is a change using BM09 – ST forms. OBI. 01; BM10 – ST. OBI.01. 10. Refund of rented premises (this does not apply to Floors 4, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10) - The TENANT needs to contact the MO as soon as there is a decision, the agreement not to continue the lease. - The Lessor, the MO only agrees to receive the leased premises from the TENANT when: a. The TENANT fulfills the financial obligations set forth in the "Lease". b. The premises are restored in accordance with the original status quo as described in the "Minutes of Handover of premises". The MO encourages the TENANT to complete the restoration of the office to its original status at least 3 working days before the end of the lease to facilitate the joint inspection between the TENANT and the Lessor before officially returning the premises. Fire Detector - Shouting: "Fire, burn, burn." - Activate fire alarms by pulling levers at emergency press boxes installed along escape routes to notify the Building that there is a fire. - Take everyone out of the room with the fire and close the door to prevent smoke and fire 27 BUILDING HANDBOOK|

CII TOWER 152 Dien Bien Phu - Ward 25 - Binh Thanh District - Ho Chi Minh City from spreading. - Try to fight fires with available fire extinguishers such as fire extinguishers and fire hydrants, taking care not to endanger yourself and others. b. Tenants, Visitors, Contractors - Upon hearing the first fire alarm, everyone must put away all important documents, cash and turn off all machines etc., calm down and listen to instructions from the public speaker system. Do not make unnecessary phone calls to verify why the fire alarm goes off, and do not use elevators. - Upon hearing the evacuation statement, everyone must immediately evacuate the Building by the nearest exit and reach the gathering point in an orderly manner. c. Evacuate only when: - There are notices of evacuation transmitted through the public loudspeaker system; or - Second fire alarm continuous broadcast; or - Be informed by the people in charge of the fire protection work of the floor. d. Important notes during evacuation: - Do not panic to rush to the stairs by the nearest emergency exit and go to the gathering point. ELEVATORS ARE NOT ALLOWED. - Go to the meeting point as indicated by the staff on the ground floor. - All TENANTS / Customers/Visitors/Contractors are not allowed to enter the Building unless authorized by the Fire Protection Police. e. Who to contact - If there is anything to know about fire safety, contact to PM and the captain of the security team. f. Responsibilities of each person - The following are for the benefit of each person him/herself. - Immediately press the fire alarm button to activate the fire alarm when a fire is detected. - When there is a fire, do not panic or lose your temper because it is easy to lead to confusion. - Must know where to put the nearest fire extinguisher, fire alarm button and nozzle and know how to use them. - Must know the emergency exit route to escape the fire in the event of a fire so always keep the stairs, these exits are neat without obstacles at all times. - Do not use the elevator during a fire. 28 BUILDING HANDBOOK|
